annotation: Transmembrane channel-like 1. Core pore-forming pore of the auditory mechanotransduction complex gating endolymphatic cation entry in cochlear hair cells.
26S proteasome complex subunit. Chaperone maintaining proteostatic fidelity under severe aerobic flight stress in bats.
Calcium and integrin binding protein 2. Essential auxiliary subunit of the TMC1 mechanotransduction channel.
Protocadherin-15. Lower strand of the stereocilia tip-link tether gating mechanical shear into ion flux.
Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase family member 15. Frequent-flier locus governing post-translational ADP-ribosylation under metabolic stress.
Mucolipin TRP cation channel 3. Regulates endolymphatic calcium and organellar trafficking in sensory hair cells.
Vesicular glutamate transporter 3 (VGLUT3). Drives rapid synaptic transmission at cochlear inner hair cell ribbon synapses.
Myomesin-2. Structural elasticity protein in laryngeal vocal folds supporting ultrasonic vocal buzzing > 200 Hz.
Proteasome 26S ATPase subunit 2. Essential regulatory particle driving ATP-dependent protein degradation under flight stress.
Prestin. Outer hair cell piezoelectric motor driving cochlear somatic motility and frequency amplification.
Lipoxygenase homology domains 1. Shaft tensioner maintaining hair cell stereocilia structural bundle rigidity.
Proteasome 26S ATPase subunit 5. Regulatory particle governing proteasomal substrate translocation during hyper-metabolic demand.
CD1c molecule. Frequent-flier presenting lipid and glycolipid antigens during metabolic and dietary diversification.
Transmembrane serine protease 3. Required for cochlear hair cell maintenance and auditory sensitivity.
